scope: Reuse observations of identical integer anchors within one request's first-service record. No cross-observation cache, policy change, or physical reuse inference.

same_version_evidence.interpretation: Repeated identity observations are present on both actual paths. These counts are not a measured CPU or JCT saving.

cpu_comparison.limitations: CPU fixture of complete on_launch; transfer proof, prefix-probe queueing, usage publication and CUDA probes excluded identically. Distinct/missing anchors add small overhead. No-host-hit medians are nearly unchanged, but some means have outliers; retain every case. Not GPU/JCT benefit.

validation.coverage: Identical and different first-service anchors, preserved record identity/provenance, and refreshed node creation time on the next observation; existing telemetry and comparison behavior.
